title: Reading an execution plan
claim: EXPLAIN shows the plan without running the query; EXPLAIN ANALYZE runs it and adds real timings.
Watch estimated vs actual rows, scan types (Seq Scan vs Index Scan), join methods and the costliest node.
verdict: Confirmed. The plan shows the query walking metric_date_c backwards and filtering by consumer: thousands of rows
are read and thrown away to return 50 (Rows Removed by Filter). The first run had to fetch those pages
({first:metrics_list}), repeats found them in cache ({t:metrics_list}). BUFFERS explains most 'same query,

sections.label: 1. EXPLAIN: the plan the optimizer picked, estimates only (the query is not executed)
sections.sql:
EXPLAIN
SELECT id, date_c, url, duration, httpcode FROM metric
 WHERE consumerid = 'consumer-010' AND date_c >= localtimestamp - interval '30 days'
 ORDER BY date_c DESC LIMIT 50;
sections.output:
QUERY PLAN                                             
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Limit  (cost=0.44..418.45 rows=50 width=60)
   ->  Index Scan Backward using metric_date_c on metric  (cost=0.44..36283.81 rows=4340 width=60)
         Index Cond: (date_c >= (LOCALTIMESTAMP - '30 days'::interval))
         Filter: ((consumerid)::text = 'consumer-010'::text)
(4 rows)

sections.label: 2. EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS): executed; actual rows, time per node and pages (hit = cache, read = disk/OS)
sections.sql:
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
SELECT id, date_c, url, duration, httpcode FROM metric
 WHERE consumerid = 'consumer-010' AND date_c >= localtimestamp - interval '30 days'
 ORDER BY date_c DESC LIMIT 50;
sections.output:
QUERY PLAN                                                                  
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Limit  (cost=0.44..418.45 rows=50 width=60) (actual time=0.097..9.903 rows=50 loops=1)
   Buffers: shared hit=36 read=152
   I/O Timings: read=9.221
   ->  Index Scan Backward using metric_date_c on metric  (cost=0.44..36283.81 rows=4340 width=60) (actual time=0.096..9.894 rows=50 loops=1)
         Index Cond: (date_c >= (LOCALTIMESTAMP - '30 days'::interval))
         Filter: ((consumerid)::text = 'consumer-010'::text)
         Rows Removed by Filter: 5088
         Buffers: shared hit=36 read=152
         I/O Timings: read=9.221
 Planning:
   Buffers: shared hit=212
 Planning Time: 0.338 ms
 Execution Time: 9.923 ms
(13 rows)
